class.name: KeyBindingList
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [KeyBindingSettingsServer]: the key bindings of all actions.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"key_bindings"[/code]: one [KeyBinding] per bound slot of every action, grouped by action. It holds nothing but the list, so [KeyBindingSettingsServer] can store it as CSV with one row per event. [KeyBindingSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]); use the methods of [KeyBindingSettingsServer] to change the bindings.

members.member: The rows, one per slot. An action without any binding has one empty row that carries its [member KeyBinding.deadzone].
